name: AL-04
label: Safe R

key_factors: R+33 partisan lean in a deeply red Alabama district
Longtime incumbent Aderholt with $750K cash on hand
model.rationale: The baseline of R+23.8 rests on a massive partisan lean, incumbent advantage, and a lopsided fundraising gap; no evidence justifies moving away from it. Aderholt is a Safe R favorite.
model.watch: Only a major unforeseen scandal or incumbent retirement-level shock could put this in play.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Northwest Alabama's 4th district is one of the most Republican-leaning seats in the country, with a partisan lean of R+33. Robert Aderholt has held the seat since 1997 and is seeking another term with the advantages of incumbency and a large financial edge: he raised over $1 million and holds roughly $750,000 on hand, while Democrat Amanda Pusczek raised about $16,000 with under $500 remaining. Prediction markets give Aderholt about a 98% chance of winning.

No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, so the forecast rests on fundamentals, which all point the same direction. The expected margin is roughly R+25, with modest uncertainty given the absence of polling but overwhelming structural advantages for the incumbent.
